registryRows.label: Pipe Layout (CD)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a new drainage pipe with pipe basics, flow and invert controls.

registryRows.label: Pit Layout (PIT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Place a new pit with type, size, cover and schedule controls.

registryRows.label: Quick Plastic Pit (PP)
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the normal pit placement flow prefilled as a 350 x 350 plastic pit.

registryRows.label: Edit Pit or Pipe (CDEDIT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Select a pit or pipe and open the correct edit workflow.

registryRows.label: Inspector
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE Inspector context palette.

registryRows.label: Solve Run Inverts (CDRUNSOLVE)
registryRows.shortDesc: Pick a start pit, solve inverts/grades for the whole downstream run, preview and apply.

registryRows.label: Downpipe (DP)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a downpipe source block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Inspection Opening (IO)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert an inspection opening source block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Overflow (OF)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert an overflow source block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Front Overflow (FO)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a front overflow source block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Trench Grate (CDTG)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a trench grate source block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Raingarden (CDRG)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a raingarden polyline outline with solid hatch and GIO block.

registryRows.label: Slab Fall Design (CDSLAB)
registryRows.shortDesc: Design slab or hardstand fall using TIN triangulation — places fall symbols and spot levels automatically.

registryRows.label: Import Existing Slab (CDSLABIMPORT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Adopt an existing pre-drawn slab boundary + sawcuts + fall arrows into the CE data model. Use this when the slab was drawn manually and you want CDDASHBOARD / CDINSPECTOR / CDEDIT to recognise it.

registryRows.label: Spoon Drain (CDSPOON)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a closed spoon drain outline within a slab — becomes a hatch island when CDSLAB is run.

registryRows.label: GIO Block (GIO)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a standalone GIO gross inlet block and auto-tag it.

registryRows.label: Load Survey (CDSURVEY)
registryRows.shortDesc: Load a land surveyor DWG file and store ground RLs for pit cover level suggestions.

registryRows.label: Source Tag (CDTAG)
registryRows.shortDesc: Tag, retag or repair source block identifiers. Also used to register non-standard blocks (AGI, watertank, council blocks) into the CE data model.

registryRows.label: Pit Schedule
registryRows.shortDesc: Review, override, compare and place pit schedule data.

registryRows.label: Longitudinal Profile (CDPROFILE)
registryRows.shortDesc: Select an upstream pit and generate a longitudinal-section block to the drawing.

registryRows.label: Civil Hub
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the read-only Civil Hub for network health, plan navigation and safe hand-off to existing Civil tools.

registryRows.label: Design Check Dashboard
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the design-check dashboard: network topology, naming, cover depth and schedule drift in one filterable view.

registryRows.label: Delete Pit
registryRows.shortDesc: Delete a pit and its linked label and cover text. To be replaced by an entity-deletion reactor in v2.1 — use ERASE + CDSYNC in the meantime.

registryRows.label: Move Arrow (CDMA)
registryRows.shortDesc: Move a pipe flow arrow to a better segment or position.

registryRows.label: Move Text Segment
registryRows.shortDesc: Relocate pipe text to a different segment.

registryRows.label: Edit Annotation (CDANNOTATIONEDIT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Move, rotate, mirror, or flip an individual CE annotation (invert text, pipe text, flow arrow) without disturbing the rest of the compound entity.

registryRows.label: CE Manager
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE Drawing Standards Manager (layer colours, draw order, label styles).

registryRows.label: Preferences (CDS)
registryRows.shortDesc: Open preferences for drafting, defaults, label styles and behaviour.

registryRows.label: Compare Import
registryRows.shortDesc: Compare imported data against the current drawing model.

registryRows.label: Export Entities
registryRows.shortDesc: Export entity geometry and schedule references.

registryRows.label: Repair Center
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the repair center for sync, rebuild, upgrade and diagnostics.

registryRows.label: Drawing Discipline
registryRows.shortDesc: View or set whether this drawing is Civil or Structural — keeps civil tools out of structural drawings.

registryRows.label: Feedback & Bug Report
registryRows.shortDesc: Report a bug or submit a suggestion. Saves a report file you can send to CE support.

registryRows.label: Data Diagnostics (CDDIAG)
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE data model diagnostic view — inspect pits, pipes and links, and export a JSON report for support.

registryRows.label: Help & Status
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the task guide, version info and workflow help hub.

registryRows.label: Label Styles (folded into CDS)
registryRows.shortDesc: Folded into CDS Preferences in v2.0. Open CDS and go to the Label Styles tab.

registryRows.label: Import X-Civil
registryRows.shortDesc: Import X-Civil data. Temporarily hidden — scheduled for v3 rework.

registryRows.label: Import LandXML
registryRows.shortDesc: Import LandXML drainage data. Temporarily hidden — scheduled for v3 rework.

registryRows.label: Export Corpus
registryRows.shortDesc: Export drawing data for ML corpus workflows. Admin/developer use only.

registryRows.label: Check Consultant DWG
registryRows.shortDesc: Read-only check of a consultant DWG: layer recognition coverage and project data QA findings.

registryRows.label: Manual Pipe Link
registryRows.shortDesc: Legacy manual pipe-to-pit link. Use CDPIPEOVERRIDE instead.

registryRows.label: Clear Manual Link
registryRows.shortDesc: Legacy clear manual link. Use CDPIPEOVERRIDECLEAR instead.

registryRows.label: Sync Links
registryRows.shortDesc: Relink pits and pipes from drawing geometry.

registryRows.label: Rebuild Project Data
registryRows.shortDesc: Rebuild and repair project data for the current drawing.

registryRows.label: Register Unregistered Pipes
registryRows.shortDesc: Register manually-drawn polylines on CE pipe layers into the project network.

registryRows.label: Upgrade Existing Drawing
registryRows.shortDesc: Upgrade legacy or external drawings into CE-managed data.

registryRows.label: Recover Inverts
registryRows.shortDesc: Recreate invert persistence and text from stored project data.

registryRows.label: Audit
registryRows.shortDesc: Audit current project data and schedule health.

registryRows.label: Focus Windows
registryRows.shortDesc: Bring CE windows back to the foreground.

registryRows.label: Triage
registryRows.shortDesc: Collect diagnostics for difficult drawing issues.

registryRows.label: Refresh CE Blocks
registryRows.shortDesc: Redefine PIT BLOCK / PIT LABEL in the current drawing from the bundled DWGs (BUG-018 rollout for old drawings).

registryRows.label: Refresh Pit Links
registryRows.shortDesc: Re-position pit-linked cover text after MIRROR or other native AutoCAD transforms that moved the pit but not the text (BUG-036).

registryRows.label: Link Pipe Endpoint
registryRows.shortDesc: Manually link a pipe endpoint to a pit or tagged source.

registryRows.label: Clear Pipe Override
registryRows.shortDesc: Clear a manual pipe endpoint override.

registryRows.label: Slab Joints Auto (CDJOINT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Auto-generate SC joint grid on a CDSLAB boundary. Select slab type (spacing) and command clips grid to boundary, avoids pits, and places SC labels.

registryRows.label: Construction Joint (CDCJ)
registryRows.shortDesc: Manually draw a construction joint (CJ) line and label on the SLAB CJ layer.

registryRows.label: Sawcut Joint (CDSC)
registryRows.shortDesc: Manually draw a sawcut joint (SC) line and label on the SLAB SC layer.

registryRows.label: Strip Drain (CDSTRIP)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a 100mm-wide closed strip drain with auto-placed floor wastes at every corner and at 12 m centres along straight runs. Prompts for justification and an external flow-direction arrow.

registryRows.label: Water Tank (CDWT)
registryRows.shortDesc: Tag a water tank block, prompt for total / detention / reuse litres, place a callout, and link Riser + Dropper sub-blocks under the same WT tag.

registryRows.label: Floor Waste (CDFW)
registryRows.shortDesc: Place a single FLOOR WASTE block at a picked point and auto-assign the next sequential FW source tag.

registryRows.label: Generic Source (CDSOURCE)
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a generic SOURCE block (e.g. ROOF DRAIN, AC UNIT) with a user-typed source ID. Not added to the pit schedule.

registryRows.label: AGI Drain (CDAGI)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a polyline as an AGI drain source on the AGI DRAIN layer (yellow, AG_LINE linetype). Auto-tags AGI1, AGI2, …

registryRows.label: Structural Root Zone (CDSRZ)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a Structural Root Zone marker circle on the SRZ layer (colour 233, HIDDEN linetype). No hatch.

registryRows.label: Tree Protection Zone (CDTPZ)
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a Tree Protection Zone marker — yellow HIDDEN circle on TPZ layer plus an associative ANSI31 hatch on the HATCH 70 layer.

registryRows.label: Suite Manager
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE Suite Manager home screen.

registryRows.label: Refresh State
registryRows.shortDesc: Refresh plugin discovery, upload queued telemetry, and reload dashboard data.

registryRows.label: Diagnostics
registryRows.shortDesc: Create and save a plain-English diagnostic report.

registryRows.label: Open Logs
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE support data folder for this machine.

registryRows.label: Admin Dashboard
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the administrator dashboard for usage, failures, and machine health.

registryRows.label: Update Control
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the administrator dashboard focused on approved releases and rollout state.

registryRows.label: Health Check
registryRows.shortDesc: Run a plain-English health check on all installed CE plugins.

registryRows.label: Support Bundle
registryRows.shortDesc: Package logs, plugin state, and diagnostics into a support bundle for troubleshooting.

registryRows.label: Admin Hub
registryRows.longDesc: Provides WPF admin tools and CLI fallback for debug toggles, bracing diagnostics, settings, and system utilities.
registryRows.notes: Replaces scattered debug/fringe commands in daily workflows.

registryRows.label: Command Help
registryRows.longDesc: Opens a searchable command help browser with short and detailed descriptions, prompts, layer behavior, and run action.
registryRows.notes: Use CEHELP first when onboarding new drafters.

registryRows.label: Drafting Standards
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CE drafting standards manager.
registryRows.longDesc: Shows CE layer, colour, linetype, lineweight, and text standards for the current drawing, audits non-standard layers, edits layer properties, and saves drawing-level standards defaults.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Audits and can update drawing layers and drafting standards.
registryRows.notes: Use this to manage CE drafting standards across the current drawing from one window.

registryRows.label: Version Information
registryRows.shortDesc: Show all loaded CE plugin versions in one window.
registryRows.longDesc: Opens the CE Suite About window with the loaded Civil, Structural and Manager versions.
registryRows.notes: Hover over a version to see the exact loaded DLL path. A duplicate load is shown as a conflict.

registryRows.label: Section Mark
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a section cut line with bubbles.
registryRows.longDesc: Prompts for cut line extents, view direction, identifier, and optional sheet reference, then places section bubbles at both ends.

registryRows.label: Level Mark
registryRows.longDesc: Prompts for level type, insertion point, side, and label value, then places the selected level symbol with linked text.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Uses 25DIMS for symbols and 25TEXT for labels.
registryRows.notes: Direct shortcuts: CE_FFL, CE_RL, CE_SSL, CE_NGL.

registryRows.label: Level Update
registryRows.longDesc: Updates the text content of selected DBText/MTEXT level labels in one operation.

registryRows.label: Arc Dimension
registryRows.longDesc: Prompts for dimension type then launches native AutoCAD DIMARC, DIMRADIUS, or DIMDIAMETER with CE layer/style restore handling.

registryRows.label: Rebar Line
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a rebar indicator line with label.
registryRows.longDesc: Creates a thickened rebar line, end ticks, and a standard bar label such as N16-200 EW using embedded AS3600 size data.

registryRows.label: Rebar Circle
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw circular bar layouts around a center.
registryRows.longDesc: Places circular bar symbols around a nominated radius and adds a quantity-size label.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Uses CE rebar layer, 18CONT outline, and 25TEXT label.

registryRows.label: Stirrup
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a stirrup/tie symbol in section.
registryRows.longDesc: Creates a rectangular stirrup/tie with hook return and label from a section bounding box and cover value.

registryRows.label: Bar Weight
registryRows.longDesc: Uses embedded AS3600 mass-per-metre data to calculate total rebar weight and optionally place the result in the drawing.

registryRows.label: Member Label
registryRows.longDesc: Adds a simple leader and text label for beams, columns, braces, or footings, with optional box or circle surround.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Uses 25DIMS for leader geometry and 25TEXT for label text.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Panel
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the dedicated CEMARKUP review window.
registryRows.longDesc: Shows the standalone CEMARKUP review window for parse, review, planning, placement, preview, and execution workflows without routing through the CETOOLS palette.
registryRows.notes: Primary entrypoint for the CEMARKUP workflow.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Benchmark
registryRows.shortDesc: Benchmark CEMARKUP parsing across a folder of PDFs.
registryRows.longDesc: Runs the CEMARKUP parse and planning workflow across multiple PDFs and writes a benchmark CSV for review and tuning.
registryRows.notes: Diagnostic/tuning tool for CEMARKUP development.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Load Package
registryRows.shortDesc: Load a saved CEMARKUP package JSON.
registryRows.longDesc: Loads a previously saved CEMARKUP package and restores its review items, command plans, and status into the live runtime.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Parse PDF
registryRows.shortDesc: Parse a markup PDF into CEMARKUP review items.
registryRows.longDesc: Prompts for a markup PDF, source mode, and project type, then builds a CEMARKUP intent package and initial execution plan.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Stores CEMARKUP package and plan artifacts only.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Replan
registryRows.shortDesc: Rebuild CEMARKUP execution plans from the current package.
registryRows.longDesc: Regenerates command plans for the active CEMARKUP package after approvals, rejections, or plan remaps change.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Updates CEMARKUP command plan state only.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Preview Next
registryRows.shortDesc: Preview the next CEMARKUP execution batch.
registryRows.longDesc: Shows the next pending CEMARKUP sub-batch, including executor, action count, confidence, and placement readiness before execution.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Register Drawing
registryRows.shortDesc: Register the active drawing for CEMARKUP placement.
registryRows.longDesc: Captures drawing context and enriches the active CEMARKUP plans with suggested placement so native and pyautocad execution can run safely.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Reads the active drawing and updates CEMARKUP placement state.
registryRows.notes: Run this before geometric execution batches.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Run Next
registryRows.shortDesc: Execute the next approved CEMARKUP batch.
registryRows.longDesc: Runs the next pending CEMARKUP sub-batch after confirmation, using native or pyautocad execution depending on the planned executor.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Command-specific drawing changes based on approved batch actions.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Status
registryRows.shortDesc: Show current CEMARKUP package and batch status.
registryRows.longDesc: Reports the active CEMARKUP package summary, placement readiness, and next pending batch state in the command line.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Undo Last
registryRows.shortDesc: Undo the last executed CEMARKUP batch.
registryRows.longDesc: Rolls back the last executed CEMARKUP sub-batch and resets only the affected plan statuses in the current package state.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Reverts the last CEMARKUP batch changes.

registryRows.label: CEMARKUP Visual Preview
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the CEMARKUP drawing preview window.
registryRows.longDesc: Shows the visual CEMARKUP preview window with drawing geometry, interpreted items, placement markers, and callouts for the active package.

registryRows.label: STRIPLAYERSMERGE
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE utility/system command STRIPLAYERSMERGE for audit, deployment, linking, or maintenance tasks.

registryRows.label: STRUCLINKTEXT
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE utility/system command STRUCLINKTEXT for audit, deployment, linking, or maintenance tasks.

registryRows.label: CECHECKLIST
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE_STRUC_SUITE UI command CECHECKLIST to show/hide suite or CETOOLS panels.

registryRows.label: CENOTES
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the shared notes workspace across all users and jobs.
registryRows.longDesc: Opens the dedicated shared notes browser so you can search, filter, and manage notes and tags across all users and all jobs from one workspace.

registryRows.label: CESTRUC
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE_STRUC_SUITE UI command CESTRUC to show/hide suite or CETOOLS panels.

registryRows.label: Open Command Hub
registryRows.longDesc: Opens the main CETOOLS palette with JobTime, Notes, Checklist, and the Commands hub.
registryRows.notes: Primary entry for day-to-day use.

registryRows.label: CETOOLSTOGGLE
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE_STRUC_SUITE UI command CETOOLSTOGGLE to show/hide suite or CETOOLS panels.

registryRows.label: Aligned Dimension
registryRows.longDesc: Launches DIMALIGNED with closed-filled arrows and BYLAYER color/linetype/text properties.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Temporarily switches to 25DIMS, restores previous layer.

registryRows.label: DSET
registryRows.longDesc: Executes CE dimension workflow DSET with enforced dimension style/layer defaults and automatic restore handling.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Creates output on 25DIMS, then restores previous active layer.

registryRows.label: DSET 1

registryRows.label: Copy/Paste XREF

registryRows.longDesc: Runs legacy copy/paste xref helper workflows.

registryRows.label: PXREF

registryRows.label: XREF Layer Manager
registryRows.shortDesc: Analyze and normalize xref entities to target layer.
registryRows.longDesc: Runs xref entity discovery and moves xrefs to configured layer/style using saved XRL settings.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Moves xref entities to configured target layer.

registryRows.label: XRLSILENT

registryRows.label: Thickening (Registered)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a registered thickening element in a raft system.
registryRows.longDesc: Draws a rectangular thickening inside a slab perimeter, registers it in the foundation system, generates outline geometry, and places a label.

registryRows.label: Pad Footing (Registered)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a registered pad footing element.
registryRows.longDesc: Draws a rectangular pad footing, registers it in the foundation system, generates outline geometry, and places a label.

registryRows.label: Strip Footing (Registered)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a registered strip footing path element.
registryRows.longDesc: Creates a strip footing along a selected centerline path, registers it in the foundation system, and places a label parallel to the path.

registryRows.label: External Beam (Registered)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a registered external beam in a raft system.
registryRows.longDesc: Creates an external beam along a path within a slab perimeter, registers it in the raft system, and places a label parallel to the beam.

registryRows.label: Internal Beam (Registered)
registryRows.shortDesc: Create a registered internal beam in a raft system.
registryRows.longDesc: Creates an internal beam along a path within a slab perimeter, registers it in the raft system, and places a label parallel to the beam.

registryRows.label: Bored Pier
registryRows.shortDesc: Insert a bored pier block reference.
registryRows.longDesc: Inserts the 450DIABPV2 dynamic block with selected visibility state (300/450/600 DIA). Supports multiple insertion points in a loop and optional registration in a foundation system.

registryRows.label: Edit Foundation Element
registryRows.shortDesc: Edit a placed foundation element in-place.
registryRows.longDesc: Select any linked foundation entity to edit its label, size, depth, or element kind. Updates the driver geometry, FST memory, and regenerates the system.

registryRows.label: Delete Foundation System
registryRows.shortDesc: Delete an entire foundation system and all its elements.
registryRows.longDesc: Select any linked entity to identify the system, then confirm deletion. Erases all element entities (drivers, labels, outlines) and removes the system from the registry.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Erases entities from their current layers.

registryRows.label: Adopt Foundations
registryRows.shortDesc: Adopt existing geometry into the foundation system.
registryRows.longDesc: Scans the drawing for unregistered footing/slab geometry and adopts it into the appropriate foundation system.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Reads existing layers, adds XData links.

registryRows.label: Regenerate Selected System
registryRows.shortDesc: Regenerate outline geometry for a selected foundation system.
registryRows.longDesc: Select any entity linked to a system. Rebuilds the boolean union outline and re-places all labels for that system.

registryRows.label: Regenerate All Systems
registryRows.shortDesc: Regenerate outline geometry for all foundation systems.
registryRows.longDesc: Iterates every registered foundation system and rebuilds outlines and labels.

registryRows.label: FST Manager
registryRows.shortDesc: Open the FST Foundations Manager dialog.
registryRows.longDesc: Opens a two-tab WPF dialog for managing the per-drawing size library (8 footing/beam/thickening buckets with depth) and inspecting registered foundation systems and elements.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Saves size data to drawing XRecords.

registryRows.label: Export Footing Schedule
registryRows.shortDesc: Export a footing schedule to the drawing as MText.
registryRows.longDesc: Collects all registered foundation elements, groups by mark, and places a formatted footing schedule (Mark, Type, Size, Depth, Qty) as MText at a picked point.

registryRows.label: Command Palette
registryRows.shortDesc: Fuzzy-search and run any CE command.
registryRows.longDesc: Opens a spotlight-style command palette. Start typing a command name, alias, description, or group keyword — the top 12 matches are ranked by prefix, alias, and substring relevance. Press Enter or double-click to execute the selected command. Escape or clicking away closes the palette without running anything. Tip: assign Ctrl+Shift+P via AutoCAD CUSTOMIZE > Keyboard Shortcuts.
registryRows.notes: The palette searches the same command-registry.json that powers CEHELP, so all CE commands are discoverable here.

registryRows.label: Export Drawing Notes
registryRows.shortDesc: Export drawing notes to Markdown or HTML.
registryRows.longDesc: Reads all notes stored in the current drawing (the TIM_NOTES Named Object Dictionary) and exports them to a Markdown (.md) or self-contained HTML file. The HTML output includes CE amber branding, category badges, priority indicators, and resolved/open status. After export the output folder is opened in Explorer.
registryRows.notes: Only exports notes from the current drawing. Use CENOTES to view all notes before exporting.

registryRows.label: Review Recovery Snapshots
registryRows.shortDesc: Review and clear incomplete command snapshots.
registryRows.longDesc: Lists any recovery snapshot files left by commands that did not complete cleanly in a previous session (e.g. due to a crash). Shows command name, drawing path, and start time for each snapshot. Prompts to clear all snapshots. A startup notice is shown automatically if stale snapshots exist when AutoCAD loads.
registryRows.notes: Snapshots are written before each CE command and deleted on clean exit. A stale snapshot indicates the command did not finish.

registryRows.label: Steel/Timber Section
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a steel or timber beam cross-section.
registryRows.longDesc: Opens a section browser to select UB, UC, WB, WC, PFC, SHS, RHS, CHS, EA, or custom timber from the AS/NZS steel catalogue. Draws the cross-section outline with correct hatch at the current drawing scale.
registryRows.layerBehavior: BEAM layer for steel outline and hatch. 25TEXT for label. 25DIMS for dimension.
registryRows.notes: Section data from Assets/Config/section-catalogue.json. XData stored for future SPEDITSECTION.

registryRows.label: RC Beam Section
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a reinforced concrete beam cross-section.
registryRows.longDesc: Dialog-driven: enter width, depth, bottom and top bar sizes/counts, stirrup size, and cover. Draws concrete outline with ANSI37 hatch, stirrups, and rebar dots at the correct scale.
registryRows.layerBehavior: SUPPORT COLUMN for concrete. 35CONT for rebar. 25TEXT for labels. 25DIMS for dimensions.
registryRows.notes: Bar sizes from Assets/Config/rebar-catalogue.json.

registryRows.label: Rect Column
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a rectangular concrete column cross-section.
registryRows.longDesc: Dialog-driven: enter column width, depth, main bar size, bars per face, tie size, and cover. Draws concrete outline, ties, and rebar dots symmetrically arranged.
registryRows.layerBehavior: SUPPORT COLUMN for concrete. 35CONT for rebar. 25TEXT for labels. 25DIMS for dimensions.
registryRows.notes: Bar positions computed for barsPerFace including corners.

registryRows.label: Circ Column
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a circular concrete column cross-section.
registryRows.longDesc: Dialog-driven: enter diameter, total bar count, main bar size, helical/tie size, and cover. Draws concrete circle, inner tie circle, and rebar dots equally spaced around the ring.
registryRows.layerBehavior: SUPPORT COLUMN for concrete. 35CONT for rebar. 25TEXT for labels. 25DIMS for dimensions.
registryRows.notes: Bars are placed starting from 90° and equally spaced.

registryRows.label: RC Slab Section
registryRows.shortDesc: Draw a reinforced concrete slab cross-section. (Phase 3)
registryRows.longDesc: Planned for Phase 3. Will draw simply supported, continuous, or cantilever RC slab cross-sections with top/bottom rebar and dimensions.
registryRows.notes: Phase 3 placeholder.

registryRows.label: Beam Link Migrate
registryRows.shortDesc: Register legacy beams with the BeamLink reactor system.
registryRows.longDesc: Scans the drawing for beam polylines on the BEAM and BEAM LOWER layers that have no BeamLinkData, locates nearby support blocks at each endpoint and the closest beam text near the midpoint, and registers the group so moves/erases stay linked.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Reads BEAM and BEAM LOWER. No layer changes.
registryRows.notes: Idempotent — beams already linked are skipped.

registryRows.label: Beam Link Debug
registryRows.shortDesc: Dump a beam's BeamLinkData JSON to the command line.
registryRows.longDesc: Prompts for a beam polyline and prints the parsed BeamLinkData JSON to the command line so handles, roles, offsets, and orphan state can be inspected.
registryRows.notes: Diagnostic only — does not modify the drawing.

registryRows.label: Auto-Support (Preview)
registryRows.shortDesc: Dry-run: preview proposed support locations from walls and beams.
registryRows.longDesc: Reads xref walls and BEAM/BEAM LOWER lines from the current plan, runs the offline AUTO-DESIGN support brain, and draws magenta PREVIEW MARKERS (a circle plus the rule id) on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT PREVIEW' layer. It does NOT place real support blocks and does NOT modify existing geometry. Prompts for the floor plan type [Footing/Framing/Roof].
registryRows.layerBehavior: Creates the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT PREVIEW' layer (magenta, Continuous) and draws preview markers on it. No other layers touched.
registryRows.notes: Dry-run / preview only — first AutoCAD-coupled step of the AUTO-DESIGN initiative. EXPERIMENTAL in 1.0.31: hidden from the ribbon, run by typing CEAUTOSUPPORT. Erase the preview layer or run CEAUTOSUPPORTCLEAR to clear.

registryRows.label: Auto-Support Clear
registryRows.longDesc: Erases every entity on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT PREVIEW' layer in the current space, clearing the dry-run preview markers drawn by CEAUTOSUPPORT.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Erases entities on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT PREVIEW' layer. No other layers touched.
registryRows.notes: Convenience companion to CEAUTOSUPPORT. EXPERIMENTAL in 1.0.31: hidden from the ribbon, run by typing CEAUTOSUPPORTCLEAR.

registryRows.label: Auto-Support Reference (Snapshot)
registryRows.shortDesc: Snapshot existing structural framing onto a dim reference layer for comparison.
registryRows.longDesc: Scans the current space for EXISTING structural framing (beams, supports, columns, footings, slabs, bracing, rafters, joists, piers, reinforcement and structural member text) and clones it into ONE dim light-grey snapshot block drawn exactly over the originals on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT REFERENCE' layer. The snapshot is a comparison aid: run CEAUTOSUPPORT afterwards to overlay magenta proposals and visually compare them against what is actually drawn. It does NOT modify the original geometry. Re-running refreshes the snapshot rather than stacking it. Excludes xrefs, title/border layers, dimension layers and the CEAUTOSUPPORT preview layer.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Creates the dim 'CEAUTOSUPPORT REFERENCE' layer (colour 9 light grey, Continuous, non-plottable) and inserts one CEAUTOSUPPORT_REF snapshot block on it. Originals are untouched.
registryRows.notes: Comparison-overlay aid for the AUTO-DESIGN initiative. EXPERIMENTAL in 1.0.31: hidden from the ribbon, run by typing CEAUTOSUPPORTREF. Toggle the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT REFERENCE' layer off, or run CEAUTOSUPPORTREFCLEAR, to remove the snapshot. The layer is non-plottable so the dim overlay never appears on plots.

registryRows.label: Auto-Support Reference Clear
registryRows.longDesc: Removes the dim structural snapshot inserted by CEAUTOSUPPORTREF: erases the CEAUTOSUPPORT_REF snapshot block reference on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT REFERENCE' layer in the current space and purges the now-unused block definition. The original geometry is untouched.
registryRows.layerBehavior: Erases the CEAUTOSUPPORT_REF snapshot insert on the 'CEAUTOSUPPORT REFERENCE' layer and purges its block definition. No other layers touched.
registryRows.notes: Convenience companion to CEAUTOSUPPORTREF. EXPERIMENTAL in 1.0.31: hidden from the ribbon, run by typing CEAUTOSUPPORTREFCLEAR.
